    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        name,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[name]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def detect(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color = most common non-bg, but some lines use another color entirely (e.g. D5 lines are color 6, background 1)
    # detect lines as full rows/cols of the SAME color (the line color may differ from its own dominant color if many anomalies)
    # Instead: find color that appears in long runs forming the lattice
    def score(color): return len([i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==color)>=W*0.5])+len([j for j in range(W) if sum(1 for i in range(H) if g[i][j]==color)>=H*0.5])
    cand=[c for c in set(cnt) if cnt[c]>10]
    L=max(cand,key=lambda c:score(c))
    h=[i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==L)>=W*0.6]
    v=[j for j in range(W) if sum(1 for i in range(H) if g[i][j]==L)>=H*0.6]
    return bg,L,h,v

    g=G[k+' input']; b,l,h,v=detect(g)

from collections import Counter

def detect(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def runs(color):

def f(g, excl=False):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def score(color): return len([i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==color)>=W*0.6])+len([j for j in range(W) if sum(1 for i in range(H) if g[i][j]==color)>=H*0.6])
    cand=[c for c in set(cnt) if cnt[c]>=10]; L=max(cand,key=lambda c:score(c))
    h=[i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==L)>=W*0.6]
    v=[j for j in range(W) if sum(1 for i in range(H) if g[i][j]==L)>=H*0.6]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(h,h[1:]):
        row=[]
        for x,y in zip(v,v[1:]):
            cs={g[a][x],g[b][x],g[a][y],g[b][y]}
            if len(cs)==1:
                val=list(cs)[0]

                # actually rule: corners equal and that color != line color -> c; else bg

            else:

    return out

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ.get('RLM_SESSION_DIR'))
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        name,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[name]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def analyze(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def lines(col=0.7):
        r=[i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==cnt.most_common(2)[1][0])>=W*col]
        c=[j for j in range(W) if sum(1 for i in range(H) if g[i][j]==cnt.most_common(2)[1][0])>=H*col]
        return r,c
    r,c=lines(0.7)
    return bg,cnt.most_common(2)[1][0],r,c

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    g=G[k+' input']; bg,L,h,v=analyze(g)
    print(k,'bg',bg,'L',L,'h',h,'v',v,'nh',len(h),'nv',len(v))
